headline: Juventus after the 0-3: still clear favourites against Rennes
summary: Juventus host Rennes in the Europa League four days after a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio, a night when most of the stadium left early and Spalletti said his team lacked tempo and desire. Europe has been the opposite: Juventus top the 36-team league phase with 6 points from two games. Rennes lost 3-4 at Paris FC, and L'Équipe reports top scorer Estéban Lepaul, 7 goals this season, is doubtful with an ankle injury. The market still makes Juventus 60.7% favourites, against Rennes' 17.3%, and rates them 0.94 goals better.
read: Juventus are clear favourites for their third Europa League game, given a 60.7% chance against Rennes' 17.3% and rated about a goal better — but they come in off a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio that emptied the stadium early and left Spalletti talking about a lack of tempo and desire. Rennes arrive with the more open recent record, having lost 3-4 at Paris FC while conceding 10 goals in five, and likely without Lepaul, who scored a penalty hat-trick in that game before going off injured.

facts.fact: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They host Rennes four days later with the team, and the coach, under scrutiny rather than the league position.

facts.fact: Spalletti listed four things his side lacked after the Lazio defeat: tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
facts.meaning: The coach framed it as an attitude problem, which makes this a test of the squad rather than of the table.

facts.fact: Juventus are without Francisco Conceição — 9 appearances and 525 minutes this season — plus Locatelli, Yildiz, Thuram and Grabara.
facts.meaning: The wide and central midfield areas are where they are thinnest: Conceição and Locatelli are the two most-used absentees.

facts.fact: L'Équipe reports Rennes doubt Estéban Lepaul can play after he went off injured at Paris FC; he has 7 goals in 719 minutes this season.
facts.meaning: Rennes' main source of goals is in serious doubt, which changes what they can threaten with in Turin.

facts.fact: Rennes lost 3-4 away at Paris FC on 18 October, a match that featured four converted penalties.
facts.meaning: They arrive with a defence that has been opened up repeatedly — dangerous going forward, vulnerable at the back.

facts.fact: Juventus top the 36-team Europa League league phase with 6 points from two games.
facts.meaning: Europe has been the opposite of the domestic mood — they have won both league-phase matches, including a 5-0 home win over NEC Nijmegen.

facts.fact: Juventus are priced at 60.7% to win, with Rennes at 17.3%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not, and more than three times Rennes' chance — the market's view is that the Lazio result did not change the gap between the sides.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap is Juventus -0.94, with the main line at -1.

sources.fact: Juventus lost 3-0 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
Spalletti said after the Lazio defeat that his side lacked tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
Spalletti said in his pre-match press conference that he listened to the players in a meeting and had confirmation of their availability and honesty.
Most Juventus fans left the Allianz Stadium in the closing minutes of the 3-0 home defeat to Lazio.
Buffon believes Spalletti deserves time to turn things around and said the problem cannot just be the coach.
The match is Juventus's third fixture of the Europa League league phase.
Tuttosport reports Juventus's final training session before Rennes featured a small-sided game and a double defence.
Rennes lost 4-3 away at Paris FC in Ligue 1, a match that featured four converted penalties.
